Results.ReviewText: The first delivery was incorrect but quickly rectified
Results.Title: Love Weber

Results.ReviewText: Our first Weber grill, a the Spirit three burner model, lasted more than 20 years! We are repeat buyers, this time an E-210. We are retired, so we downsized a bit. We have only used it a few times, but the quality is still outstanding, and just the right size!
Results.Title: Repeat buyers

Results.ReviewText: I have purchased four Weber grills for both my NY home and Florida home and enjoy the quality of these grills. My only complaint is the casters on this Weber E-210 have partially disintegrated possibly due to the Florida heat in my garage. I don’t know if anyone else has had this problem but the casters leave black streaks on the floor and don’t turn freely.
Results.Title: Crumbly Casters

Results.ReviewText: 2nd Spirit E-210 Grill, 1st one lasted 8 years, it was easy to order and replace parts as the grill got older
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have recently purchased the weber spirit e-210 but i can say that i love it...i have cooked on it 4 or 5 times and it is great.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill for 2 to 3 people

Results.ReviewText: I assume the grill is not working as engineered- the flame is on the rear connecting rod which is perpendicular to both burners? All the grease creates fire between the burner elements along the back of grill. A little disappointing.

Results.ReviewText: Grill will easily cook 4-6 steaks depending on size or 6-8 burgers.  For a 2 person household this is very good.  The grill does not take up much deck space which is a plus.  Howerver, I've yet to easily figure out how to lower the side tray.  I might need to read the directions.
Results.Title: Very nice

Results.ReviewText: Weber grills may run a few bucks more than the competitors, but there is are reason for that: craftsmanship, quality, and durability beyond par. Save up and own the best.
Results.Title: Best grill there is

Results.ReviewText: My grill works fine very adequate for what it is. My main accolades are for the Weber staff who help me with an issue regarding the grills heating up. They were very insightful and gave me ideas of how to fix things through the phone. The issue was not with the grill itself, but how I was igniting it, and they understood and helped.
Results.Title: Excellent customer service

Results.ReviewText: Excellent product. No other grills compare to a Weber! Reliable and easy to use.
Results.Title: Weber grills are the BEST !

Results.ReviewText: We've been a Weber customer for years.we recently downsized our grill, just the 2 of us now. Our new Weber is the perfect size and we love the foldable shelves!
Results.Title: Size matters

Results.ReviewText:
This BBQ unit called my attention. It is consistent, well designed and easy to work with it.
I have cooked for many years and about to retire, this one will be my companion for many years. Positively, I recommend it. It's a winner racing horse, you can bet on it.
Results.Title: My Helper in Family Reunions

Results.ReviewText: works good for grilling steaks and other meats.  like the way it heats up so fast
Results.Title: Good job

Results.ReviewText: Great size for my small family this is my second grill I have another one at my camper on the lake I have had it for two years and it has always worked great
Results.Title: These grills are so good I have two

Results.ReviewText: This is a super little outdoor BBQ perfect for two older retirees. Have used it twice between atmospheric rivers in NORCAL, then called the ACE dealer to come show us why it wasn’t heating much past 370 degrees. He tightened the propane tank coupling the last quarter turn and now it fires up to 600+. The all wx cover is more than worth the cost as it keeps the unit clean & dry.We’re very happy with this purchase which doesn’t require disposing of charcoal ash.
Results.Title: Perfect BBQ Grill for 2+

Results.ReviewText: I have owned a Spirit 210 for about 10 years. The bottom of the cart rusted out on the first one on one corner but the grill performance was so good that I went for the same model again. 10 years no replacement parts - worth it for me. This grill has decent surface area for a family of. 3-4, it heats up fast and has no problems getting to 600 degrees, I’ve done a lot of pizza on the Spirit with a stone. I see a few upgrades on the new one, such as porcelain coated cast iron grates. My original was a NG model but it appears they have discontinued it so I bought a propane model and swapped in the valve manifold from my old one (they changed the orifice thread size - someone really wanted to stop selling this model in NG!)
Results.Title: 2nd Spirit 210 - Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane) grill is the best grill I have ever used.  It cooks evenly and even allows you to cook with out burning your food, with the burnerless middle feature. From burgers and dogs to pork chops, steaks, and vegetables this grill can do it all! My old grill that I paid less money for cooked food unevenly and was hard to control the temperature. Not this Weber it is truly a piece of American ingenuity the price is a little higher compared to other grills but with a 10 year warranty and the expert craftsmanship and design you get it is well worth the money and then some!  I absolutely love this little grill it is plenty big to feed my family of 4 and could easily fit a little more if we have company over.  Assembly wasn’t too complicated and didn’t take me too long. I have always heard Weber Grills were the best and I’m now going to be saying that to others as well. Thank you Weber for a great product!
Results.Title: I heard Weber’s are the best and THEY ARE!!!!!!!!!

Results.ReviewText:
If I use the recommendations published in the documentation provided it takes double the time recommended to reach the temperature required.
It seems as though the problem occurs with indirect heating.  Also, meat at the back of the grill heats up faster then the front.
You probably need a three burner grill at minimum.

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
